qualification.details: Project Associate-I: B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/M.S./MCA/M.Sc in CSE, Mathematics & Computing, ECE, EE, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related disciplines. Experience with embedded systems, IoT sensors, wireless communication protocols (preferably LoRa/LoRaWAN), C/C++/Python programming, Linux/Raspberry Pi/ESP platforms, and Machine Learning is preferred. Background in computer networks, IoT/embedded systems, and wireless communication, with proficiency in C/C++/Python programming and Linux/Ubuntu. Working knowledge of Machine Learning and hands-on experience with Raspberry Pi/ESP platforms, sensors, or LoRa/LoRaWAN will be preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Project Associate-I position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is September 3, 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/M.S./MCA/M.Sc degree in CSE, Mathematics & Computing, ECE, EE, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India/IIT (ISM), Dhanbad norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The salary is ₹ 31000/- per month for candidates who have qualified GATE or NET, and ₹ 25000/- per month for those without GATE/NET qualification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the link provided in the "Important Links" section of this article or by visiting the official website of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview conducted via video conferencing.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: This is a project-based research job at the Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad.

faq.question: Q9. What experience is preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Experience with embedded systems, IoT sensors, wireless communication protocols, programming languages like C/C++/Python, Linux platforms, and Machine Learning is preferred.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT (ISM) Dhanbad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand.
